properties.name: alignPes
properties.documentation: Align access units to PES packets. If true, align access units to PES packet headers. Uses adaptation field stuffing to position an access unit at the beginning of each PES packet.

properties.name: language
properties.documentation: Language of the audio stream. Specified according to the ISO 639-2 alpha code for the language descriptor.

properties.name: streamId

properties.name: useATSCBufferModel
properties.documentation: Use ATSC buffer model for AC-3. If true, use the ATSC version of the T-STD buffer model is used. This parameter applies to AC-3 streams only.

properties.name: avgBitrate

properties.name: streamConditionsMode
properties.documentation: Specifies how to proceed with the Muxing when some of its Streams are ignored (see 'condition' property of the Stream resource). The settings only make a difference for Muxings with more than one Stream. When retrieving the resource after the analysis step of the encoding has finished, 'ignoredBy' will indicate if and why it has been ignored.

properties.name: type
properties.documentation: Discriminator property for Muxing

properties.name: program
properties.documentation: Program configuration details for the Broadcast TS muxing.

properties.name: transport
properties.documentation: Transport configuration details for the Broadcast TS muxing.

properties.name: insertProgramClockRefOnPes
properties.documentation: Insert Program Clock References (PCRs) on all packetized elemementary stream packets. When false, indicates that PCRs should be inserted on every PES header. This parameter is effective only when the PCR packet identifier is the same as a video or audio elementary stream.

properties.name: pidForPMT
properties.documentation: An integer value. Packet identifier (PID) to use for Program Map Table (PMT). Recommended value is 2 x programNumber.

properties.name: programClockRefInterval
properties.documentation: Interval between Program Clock References (PCRs) in milliseconds. Defines the period between PCR fields inserted in the stream. The default value is 90ms.

properties.name: programNumber
properties.documentation: An integer value. Value for program_number field in Program Map Table (PMT). The value zero is reserved for the NIT PID entry in the PAT.

properties.name: packetIdentifier
properties.documentation: An integer value. Packet Identifier (PID) for this stream.

properties.name: rate
properties.documentation: The rate parameter determines the maximum rate in bits per second that should be used for the subtitle stream. The valid range is `100` to `60 000 000` bps or `0`. If the value is set to 0, we will examine the first 100 packets of subtitle packet data and use the highest rate that was computed. If the value is set too low, not enough to accommodate the subtitle bit-rate, then some PES packets corresponding to DVB subtitle stream will be dropped. This parameter is optional and the default value is 0.

properties.name: streamId
properties.documentation: The UUID of the subtitle stream to which this configuration belongs to. This has to be an ID of an subtitle stream that has been added to the current muxing.

properties.name: initialPresentationTimeStamp
properties.documentation: Presentation time stamp value for the first video frame. The timestamp is specified in the timescale of 90000

properties.name: initialProgramClockReference
properties.documentation: Program Clock Reference value at the beginning of the first packet for the transport stream. The PCR is specified in the timescale of 90000

properties.name: muxrate
properties.documentation: Output rate in bps. The value zero implies to use minimal rate. The minimal rate leaves approximately 15kbps of null packets in the stream.

properties.name: patRepetitionRatePerSec
properties.documentation: Program Association Table (PAT) repetition rate per second. Number of PATs per second.

properties.name: pmtRepetitionRatePerSec
properties.documentation: Program Map Table (PMT) repetition rate per second. Number of PMTs for each program per second.

properties.name: preventEmptyAdaptionFieldsInVideo
properties.documentation: If true, prevents adaptation fields with length field equal to zero in video, i.e., zero-length AF. Please note that this condition can only occur when pesAlign for the input stream is set to true.

properties.name: stopOnError
properties.documentation: Stop mux on errors. If true, implies halt multiplexing when any error is encountered. If false, errors are ignored and multiplexing continues. Note that the recovery from an error will usually result in an illegal transport stream and artifacts on a decoder.

properties.name: variableMuxRate
properties.documentation: When false, the output stream is created at a constant bit rate. When true, the output rate is allowed to vary from a maximum rate set by the muxrate parameter down to the minimum required to carry the stream.

properties.name: alignPes
properties.documentation: Align access units to PES packets. If true, align access units to PES packet headers. Uses adaptation field stuffing to position an access unit at the beginning of each PES packet.

properties.name: insertAccessUnitDelimiterInAvc
properties.documentation: If true, add access unit delimiters (AUD) to AVC stream if AUD is missing from input elementary stream.

properties.name: maxDecodeDelay
properties.documentation: Maximum Decoder Delay in 90 KHz cycles. When non-zero, the difference between the PCR and the DTS for each picture as it is inserted into the output transport stream is limited to this number of 90 KHz cycles. Values below 1000 are treated as 0 and ignored. Valid Range [0, 1000-900000]

properties.name: streamId
properties.documentation: The UUID of the stream to which this configuration belongs to. This has to be a ID of a stream that has been added to the current muxing.
